Per-token emotion activation — transcript viewer

gemma-4-31b-it (base) · emotion-elicitation transcripts.

What this is. An interactive viewer of per-token emotion activation inside gemma-4-31b-it (base) on emotion-elicitation transcripts. Pick an experiment (rate = the model rates each of the 8 emotions 0-5; feel = open-ended "how do you feel") and a scenario; each token of the full transcript (user prompt + model response) is heat-colored by how active the selected emotion direction is at that token, double-centered across all emotions and all transcripts (red = above that emotion's baseline, blue = below). Hover any token for its top emotions.
Example transcripts — per-token emotion activation (centered across all emotions & transcripts)

Pick an experiment + scenario emotion + framing (no framing / minsys / roleplay). Each token of the full transcript (user prompt + model response) is heat-colored by its probe activation, double-centered (minus the emotion's global baseline across all transcripts, and minus the token's mean over emotions) — same scheme as the on-policy movie. Each token is colored for the selected emotion: red = above that emotion's baseline, blue = below. Switch the layer (L20 = mid-network, L40 = late) to see where the signal lives. Hover a token for its top emotions. Only framings with data for the chosen scenario are listed — in feel, some emotions (e.g. anger, jealousy) have no "no framing" transcripts because the model declines to report that feeling without a persona prompt, so only minsys/roleplay appear.
